verdict.rationale: Restate documents first-party integrations for the Vercel AI SDK and the OpenAI Agents SDK, covering both an AI SDK and an agent framework. The docs claim these give fault-tolerant execution with automatic retries and durable state, and that "a few lines" make an agent durable. The evidence is limited to one-line summaries and does not show model-provider integrations, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented model-provider integrations, evidence of breadth across more agent frameworks, detail on how the wrappers remove glue code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code

citations.quote: The Vercel AI SDK is an excellent fit for Restate integration.
Integrate OpenAI Agents SDK with Restate for fault-tolerant agent execution with automatic retries and durable state.
A few lines turn your agent into a durable agent.
Every LLM call, tool execution, and routing decision is durably persisted.
